name: Pangolin-Site
description: Pangolin Site acts as a tunneled gateway for your local network, enabling seamless zero-trust remote access through the Pangolin (https://github.com/fosrl/pangolin) platform. It securely routes traffic to your Unraid services without complex port forwarding or exposure to the public internet. Chat with us on Discord! https://pangolin.net/discord

paths.name: Docker Socket Path
paths.description: Mount the Docker socket for container discovery integration.

variables.name: PANGOLIN_ENDPOINT
variables.description: This is the full URL of the Pangolin instance. Example: https://app.pangolin.net

variables.name: SITE_ID
variables.description: This is the unique ID of the Pangolin Site. Example: 31frd0uzbjvp721

variables.name: SITE_SECRET
variables.description: This is the secret key of the Pangolin Site. Example: h51mmlknrvrwv8s4r1i210azhumt6isgbpyavxodibx1k2d6

variables.name: DOCKER_SOCKET
variables.description: Set the Docker socket container path for container discovery integration.
